The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. description:
**About Us**  

Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Visa's Corporate IT (CIT) organization is on a transformational journey to redefine how enterprise technology enables global business scale, resilience, and employee productivity. We are moving beyond traditional infrastructure models toward software\-defined, automated, cloud\-integrated platforms that deliver security, reliability, and exceptional user experience at global scale.


As part of this journey, the candidate will join a platform engineering team as a backend and systems\-focused engineer, designing, developing, and implementing cross\-platform client software and large\-scale back\-end microservices. The ideal candidate will bring extensive experience building solutions for functionally complex, large\-volume, high\-throughput, data\-centric distributed systems, with strong hands\-on depth in Go and Java.


The successful candidate is expected to be a design, coding, and configuration expert, and will help advance the engineering craft of the team related to architecture, distributed\-systems design, code quality, scalability, resiliency, and CI/CD.


The candidate should enjoy working on diverse technologies and functionally complex, data\-centric distributed applications, should be excited to take initiatives to solve complex systems problems, and get the job done while taking on new challenges. You should thrive in team\-oriented, fast\-paced environments where each team member is vital to the overall success of the projects.

**Key responsibilities**:

**Primary**:

* Design, build, and maintain a cross\-platform agent/plugin in Go (Golang).
* Design and build back\-end microservices and APIs in Java / Spring Boot with a high level of scalability, resiliency, and monitoring.
* Build and operate an Apache Kafka–based streaming pipeline (producers/consumers), including partitioning, consumer groups, and delivery/lag management, across an Active/Active multi–data\-center topology.
* Containerize and deploy services using Docker and Kubernetes, and help define deployment, scaling, and operational patterns.
* Work with data stores — ClickHouse (or an equivalent columnar/analytical store), PostgreSQL, and Redis — including schema/data\-model design and building efficient queries.
* Design and build GenAI\-powered features and integrations — e.g., natural\-language interfaces, LLM\-assisted workflows, and agentic automation — integrating with LLM APIs and tooling.
* Contribute to the React front end as needed (secondary to back\-end/agent work) and collaborate with UI\-focused engineers on API contracts.
* Manage complex, multi\-service dependencies across environments and data centers.
* Work with business partners, TPMs, and Product Managers to drive user\-story grooming, functional/technical specifications, workflow designs, and use cases.
* Contribute to and help shape engineering best practices for the team.
* Stay abreast of emerging technologies, conduct POCs to prove concepts, and select the best solution approach.
* Work with limited direction within a complex distributed environment to drive delivery of solutions and meet service levels.
* Must be self\-motivated with the ability to work in a fast\-paced agile delivery model, collaborating with effective communication, quality, integrity, and reliable delivery.


This is a hybrid position. Expectation of days in the office will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

**Qualifications**

**Basic Qualifications**:

* 2\+ years of relevant work experience and a Bachelor's degree, OR 5\+ years of relevant work Experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**:

* 3 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor's Degree, or more than 2 years of work experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g., Masters, MBA, JD, MD)
* 5 or more years of relevant experience in application development (designing, coding, and testing), with strong hands\-on depth in back\-end and systems programming.
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science or another Engineering discipline.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Go (Golang), building cross\-platform plugins/agents.
* Solid experience in core Java and Spring Boot, building production back\-end services; multithreaded/concurrent and high\-throughput processing experience is important.
* Hands\-on experience with Apache Kafka (producers/consumers, partitioning, consumer groups, offsets/lag, delivery semantics).
* Experience with Docker and Kubernetes — building, containerizing, deploying, and operating services.
* Solid experience with microservices architecture and distributed\-systems design — service decomposition, inter\-service communication (REST/messaging), statelessness, fault tolerance, and designing for scalability, high availability, and multi–data\-center (Active/Active) operation.
* Demonstrated knowledge of RDBMS and SQL, with hands\-on PostgreSQL experience; ability to build complex queries from a solid understanding of the data model.
* Experience with ClickHouse or an equivalent columnar / analytical database (or willingness to ramp quickly), and with Redis for caching.
* Experience building GenAI / LLM integrations — working with LLM APIs, prompt engineering, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), and/or agent/tool (function\-calling, MCP) integrations — and applying them to real product features.
* Experience configuring CI/CD pipelines using industry\-standard tools such as Git and Jenkins.
* Working knowledge of a modern JavaScript framework (React preferred).
* A fast learner and quick adapter — able to ramp rapidly on new technologies, domains, and unfamiliar codebases, and to be productive with limited direction.
* Enjoy working fast and smart, and able to grasp complex concepts and build algorithms from scratch.
* Proficiency with Agile development techniques.
* Strong interpersonal, facilitation, and communication (written and verbal) skills, with the ability to present complex ideas clearly.
* Ability to work in a complex organization to determine business and customer needs and provide the best solution.
* Candidate must be able to proficiently multi\-task, with a strong teamwork focus and the ability to foster collaboration within and across teams.
* Passionate about learning and applying new technologies and takes pride in delivering working software.

title: Software Eng - Content Management Systems
description:
Marcom is the creatively\-led global team that oversees Apple’s consumer facing marketing. We ensure the flawless development and execution of world\-class communications across all medias and platforms. Every day, hundreds of millions of Apple customers around the world interact with our products. We drive the strategy and creative work that provide both new and existing customers with simple, engaging and inspiring marketing experiences.  

Marcom's Interactive Engineering team works on many high\-impact projects that serve various Apple lines of business. We use the latest in open source technologies and continue to evolve and deliver solutions on a worldwide scale. Working with a variety of multi\-functional teams, the Interactive Engineering group brings it all together to deliver the interactive experiences with an excellent group of software engineers while having fun along the way. This team is exciting and fast\-paced; it’s a great place for people with exacting standards who want their work to matter.  

We are looking for a Software Engineer with 3\+ years of experience to design, develop, and enhance modern, distributed, scalable, and high\-performance Content Management Systems (CMS) using Java, open\-source technologies, and modern software engineering practices. This role is critical to the evolution of Apple’s brand as you will be working with the teams taking apple.com to the next phase of its evolution. We are looking for engineers who are passionate about building modern CMS platforms, solving complex content management problems at scale, and leveraging AI\-assisted engineering and agentic workflows to improve both CMS capabilities and software development productivity.  

  

**Description**  

This role provides an opportunity to build modern, distributed, and large\-scale Content Management Systems that power apple.com and enable content to be created, managed, governed, and delivered across multiple digital experiences.  

You will work across Java backend services, CMS platforms, content architecture, content modeling, workflows, APIs, integrations, search, distributed systems, cloud technologies, and AI\-powered engineering workflows.  

The role is suited for an engineer who enjoys solving complex CMS problems at scale and is excited about the evolution of CMS platforms through headless architectures, open\-source technologies, automation, and AI agents.  

The primary focus of this role is CMS engineering.","responsibilities":"Design, develop, customize, and extend the distributed, large\-scale CMS platforms that power apple.com and other Apple digital experiences, supporting high volumes of content.  

Build and enhance capabilities across the content lifecycle, including content creation, modeling, relationships, metadata, taxonomy, workflows, approvals, versioning, localization, publishing, and delivery.  

Work hands\-on with Java\-based open\-source CMS platforms and frameworks and extend their capabilities to meet evolving product and business requirements.  

Design and develop headless and API\-first CMS solutions enabling content delivery across web, mobile, and other digital channels.  

Develop and integrate REST and GraphQL APIs for content authoring, management, preview, search, and delivery using Java and Spring Boot.  

Build integrations between CMS platforms and search, digital asset management, identity, analytics, CDN, and other enterprise systems.  

Design solutions for scalability, high availability, resiliency, fault tolerance, and efficient content delivery in distributed environments.  

Implement caching, indexing, asynchronous processing, and event\-driven mechanisms for large\-scale CMS workloads.  

Work with databases and data models supporting large content repositories and efficient content retrieval.  

Develop and maintain supporting backend services and microservices in Java, using Spring Boot and related frameworks, based on the CMS architecture.  

Deploy and operate CMS services using Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud platforms.  

Troubleshoot and resolve CMS, performance, scalability, integration, and production issues, including JVM\-level performance and memory tuning.  

Develop unit, integration, and API tests using JUnit and related Java testing frameworks, and contribute to CI/CD and engineering automation.  

Participate in technical design discussions, code reviews, and continuous improvement of the CMS platform.  

Leverage AI coding assistants and AI agents to improve development productivity, code quality, testing, documentation, and engineering workflows.  

Explore and build AI\-powered capabilities and agentic workflows for CMS use cases, where appropriate.

**Preferred Qualifications**  

Hands\-on experience with Java\-based CMS or content platforms and their extension APIs.  

Experience with DAM or PIM solutions and integrations supporting content\-as\-a\-service at scale.  

Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud platforms for deploying JVM services.  

Experience with caching and search technologies such as Redis, Memcached, Elasticsearch, or Solr.  

Experience with event\-driven architectures using Kafka or similar messaging systems.  

Experience with modern JavaScript frameworks (React / Vue / Angular) for CMS authoring interfaces.  

Hands\-on experience using AI/ML tools and AI coding assistants to accelerate development, testing, and operational excellence.  

  

**Minimum Qualifications**  

3\+ years of professional software development experience building scalable, highly available backend and web applications in Java.  

Hands\-on experience with Java (Java 11 or later) and the Spring / Spring Boot ecosystem, including dependency injection, Spring MVC, and Spring Data.  

A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent work experience, with a focus on fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, and object\-oriented design.  

Experience designing and developing RESTful and/or GraphQL web services in Java.  

Working knowledge of SQL and NoSQL databases and data modeling for content\-heavy applications.  

Experience with Java build and CI/CD tooling such as Maven or Gradle, Git, and Jenkins.  

Experience writing unit and integration tests with JUnit, Mockito, or similar frameworks.

title: AI Platform Engineer
description:
**About Starburst**
-------------------



Starburst delivers enterprise intelligence at scale by giving organizations secure, governed access to all their data, wherever it lives. Built for distributed data environments, Starburst helps enterprises power AI and analytics without the cost and complexity of traditional data consolidation. With open standards including Trino and Apache Iceberg, Starburst enables trusted access to complete enterprise context while helping organizations avoid vendor lock\-in. Leading global enterprises trust Starburst to fuel AI, analytics, and enterprise intelligence. Learn more at starburst.ai.

#### **About the Team**



We build the AI layer for Starburst's products, including AIDA. We design agents that let users ask questions in natural language and get accurate, grounded answers backed by their actual data. We operate with startup speed inside an enterprise company, shipping weekly and measuring results. This is the first dedicated platform engineering hire on the team.


#### **Role Summary**



You will build the shared development primitives that make multiple product teams faster, with clean abstractions across the Python/JVM boundary. This role is a force multiplier: instead of building product features directly, you build the platform, SDK, and tooling that enables every other engineer on the team to ship faster.



You will own the developer experience for agent development at Starburst, building from 0 to 1 and scaling across teams. Your work is measured by other engineers' velocity, not your own feature output.


#### **As an AI Platform Engineer at Starburst, you will:**


* Design and build an agent development SDK that abstracts common patterns (tool registration, context management, evaluation hooks, prompt management)
* Build the language bridge between Python (AI ecosystem) and JVM (Starburst platform) with type safety, error propagation, and observability across the boundary
* Create developer tooling: local development environments, debugging tools, test harnesses, CI integration
* Define and maintain API contracts between the AI layer and the Starburst platform
* Build shared infrastructure: model gateway, observability pipeline, experiment framework
* Develop unified, product\-agnostic components used across multiple products
* Own platform health beyond feature delivery: performance, reliability, developer ergonomics

#### **Some of the things that we look for:**


* 5\+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 2 years building platform, infrastructure, or developer tooling
* Proficiency in both Python and JVM languages (Java or Kotlin)
* Experience designing APIs and SDKs consumed by other engineering teams
* Strong distributed systems fundamentals: RPC, serialization, error handling, observability
* Experience with containerization, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred)
* Track record of building tools that measurably improve other engineers' velocity

#### **Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience with LLM integration patterns: model APIs, token management, streaming, tool use
* Experience with cross\-language interop (gRPC, FFI, language bridges)
* Open\-source contributions to developer tooling or infrastructure projects
* Familiarity with A/B testing frameworks and experiment infrastructure
* Experience supporting both research and production workloads on the same platform
* Java agent framework experience (LangChain4j)
* **Ability to Travel**: This role will require 25% in\-person travel for purposes including but not limited to new hire onboarding, team and department offsites, customer engagements, and other company events. Actual travel expectations may vary by role and business needs.

**Build your career at Starburst**

All\-Stars have the opportunity and freedom to realize their true potential. By building alongside top talent, we're empowered to take ownership of our careers and drive meaningful change. Anchored in industry\-proven technology and unprecedented success, All\-Stars are taking on the challenge everyday to disrupt our industry – and the future.



Our global workforce is supported by a competitive Total Rewards program that reflects our commitment to a rewarding and supportive work environment. This includes a variety of benefits like competitive pay, attractive stock grants, flexible paid time off, and more.



We are committed to fostering an intentional, inclusive, and diverse culture that drives deep engagement, authentic belonging, and an exceptional All\-Star experience. * Experience working with databases, data modelling, and writing efficient queries.
